europe_now.title: Suspected Russian Spy Linked to German Airport Drone Attack
europe_now.summary: Investigators have identified a suspected Russian intelligence operative behind a drone attack targeting an airport in Germany. The incident has raised major security concerns regarding critical infrastructure protection across the region.

sources.headline: Suspected Russian spy behind drone attack in Leipzig

europe_now.title: Russian Drone Strikes Passenger Train Near Polish Border
europe_now.summary: A passenger train traveling toward the Polish border was struck by a drone during ongoing military attacks in the region. The cross-border impact of the strike has prompted urgent security evaluations among neighboring European states.

sources.headline: Drone hits Kyiv-Warsaw train close to Polish border during Russian attacks on Ukraine
Russian drone hits passenger train headed from Kyiv to Warsaw

top_stories.title: Swedish General Election
top_stories.summary: Voters across Sweden are casting ballots in a tightly contested general election with potential implications for the far-right's role in government. Political observers are closely monitoring the outcome as polling indicates a pivotal moment for the country's political landscape.

sources.headline: Swedish far-right eyes role in government
Sweden election: A turning point for the far right?

top_stories.title: German Protests After Far-Right Electoral Success
top_stories.summary: Large crowds have gathered in various German cities to demonstrate following recent electoral victories by the far-right Alternative for Germany party. Organizers and participants are expressing strong opposition to the party's political gains through widespread public rallies.

sources.headline: Germany: Thousands rally against far-right after AfD victory
